goal: Every agent-kit work session should end with a brief of what was done, what comes next and why it matters, with evidence kept the same way each time and a release note a person can read, in the kit and in other projects.
changed: New debrief skill: a four-part brief, kept as .changes/<date>-<slug>.json when a change ships.
debrief.py writes an empty record, checks records, prints the brief and prints release notes.
beau-mode replies give each next step its source, reason and impact; Opening a PR writes the record.
.changes/ is bookkeeping for receipt.py and check-product.py.
Nothing enforces the record yet: an agent that skips the step is not stopped.

claims.claim: debrief.py refuses a VERIFIED claim with no kept output, an untracked or ignored evidence path, and a next item without source, reason or impact, and accepts a complete record.
claims.check: tests/test_debrief.py (20 tests, each runs the script in a throwaway git repo) under /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6 on macOS; the full suite (986 tests) passed under Python 3.12 before the last wording edits to SKILL.md
claims.remaining: Linux, and a shallow CI clone where a claim's commit may be missing.

claims.claim: Claude Code installs bstack from this checkout and a session lists bstack:debrief.
claims.check: verify-kit: control-kit drive all against this checkout, real claude CLI, throwaway profile, no login
claims.remaining: Codex, Cursor and pi, and an install from GitHub.

claims.claim: An agent given only the skill writes a record that passes check and reports honestly.
claims.check: One sonnet subagent, given only SKILL.md and a scratch repo whose brief called the change ready to ship. Its record passed check, marked the goal as not met, and reported a crash it found; I reran the crash myself.
claims.remaining: One run on one model, before six wording fixes its feedback led to (one of them: it wrote the Verified stamp as plain text, not a trailer). The fixed text has not been trialled. No comparison against a session without the skill.

claims.claim: Agents in real sessions write the record and the brief without being asked.
claims.remaining: Needs a week of real sessions after release. The instructions it replaces were followed unevenly, so expect misses until a check enforces it.

next.item: A CI check that fails a pull request with no change record
next.why_now: This PR only asks. The baseline shows asking is not enough: 5 of agent-ledger's last 12 merged PRs had a Verification section.
next.impact: Without it you keep finding PRs with no record and no release note. With it every merged PR in an adopting repo has both.

next.item: Adopt the record in quality, agent-ledger and finances
next.why_now: Those repos have no release notes at all, and other projects were the point of the request.
next.impact: You get release notes for those repos from one command. Each needs agentfiles to sync bstack 0.26.0 first.

next.item: A Stop hook that turns a session back when a change shipped with no record
next.why_now: Not yet: it waits on R6 and on your answer to H14 in HUMAN_TASKS.md.
next.impact: The brief would run by default in Claude Code. Other tools get nothing from it.
